python.suggested_project: Build a CLI expense tracker that reads/writes JSON files

resources.title: Automate the Boring Stuff with Python (free book)

python.why_it_matters: Python is the primary language for data science, ML, backend APIs, and automation.

javascript.suggested_project: Build a to-do list app with localStorage
javascript.why_it_matters: JavaScript is the only language that runs natively in browsers. Essential for any web development role.

typescript.suggested_project: Migrate an existing JavaScript project to TypeScript
typescript.why_it_matters: TypeScript adds static typing to JavaScript, catching bugs at compile time. Now expected in most professional frontend roles.

react.suggested_project: Build a weather app that fetches data from a free public API
react.why_it_matters: React is the most widely adopted frontend library. Required or preferred in most frontend and full-stack job descriptions.

nodejs.suggested_project: Build a REST API for a blog using Node.js and Express
nodejs.why_it_matters: Node.js enables JavaScript on the server side. It is the backbone of most JavaScript backend stacks.

sql.suggested_project: Design and query a database for a library management system
sql.why_it_matters: SQL is required for almost every data or backend role. Relational databases underpin most enterprise software.

postgresql.suggested_project: Add PostgreSQL to a Flask or FastAPI app with proper migrations
postgresql.why_it_matters: PostgreSQL is the most feature-rich open-source relational database and widely used in production systems.

mongodb.suggested_project: Build a REST API with Express + MongoDB Atlas (free tier)
mongodb.why_it_matters: MongoDB is the most popular NoSQL database, commonly paired with Node.js in the MERN stack.

docker.suggested_project: Containerise a Python Flask app with a Dockerfile and docker-compose
docker.why_it_matters: Docker is the industry standard for packaging and deploying applications consistently across environments.

git.suggested_project: Contribute a small fix to any public GitHub repository
git.why_it_matters: Git is the universal version control system. It is a non-negotiable skill in every software engineering role.

machine learning.suggested_project: Train a classifier on the Titanic or Iris dataset and evaluate it properly
machine learning.why_it_matters: Machine learning is the core of AI engineering. Required for any data science or ML engineering role.

deep learning.suggested_project: Build an image classifier on CIFAR-10 using Keras
deep learning.why_it_matters: Deep learning powers modern AI — computer vision, NLP, speech. Essential for ML Engineer roles.

aws.suggested_project: Deploy a static website on S3 + CloudFront with HTTPS
aws.why_it_matters: AWS has the largest cloud market share. Cloud skills are required in most mid-to-senior engineering roles.

kubernetes.suggested_project: Deploy a 2-container app (frontend + backend) on minikube
kubernetes.why_it_matters: Kubernetes is the standard platform for deploying containerised apps at scale. Required in DevOps/cloud roles.

django.suggested_project: Build a blog with user authentication using Django
django.why_it_matters: Django is Python's most popular full-stack web framework, used by Instagram, Disqus, and many startups.

flask.suggested_project: Build a URL shortener API with Flask and SQLite
flask.why_it_matters: Flask is the lightweight Python web framework preferred for small APIs and microservices.

learning_order: File system navigation (ls, cd, cat, less)
linux.suggested_project: Set up a LAMP/LEMP stack on a free cloud VM (Oracle Free Tier)
linux.why_it_matters: Almost all servers run Linux. Shell proficiency is required for backend, DevOps, and cloud roles.

learning_order: Semantic elements (nav, header, main, section, article)
html.suggested_project: Build a personal portfolio page with semantic HTML
html.why_it_matters: HTML is the structure of every webpage. The first thing to learn for any web development path.

css.suggested_project: Style your HTML portfolio page fully with CSS Grid and Flexbox

resources.title: CSS Tricks Complete Guide to Flexbox

css.why_it_matters: CSS controls the visual presentation of every webpage. Inseparable from HTML in frontend work.

numpy.suggested_project: Implement matrix multiplication from scratch, then verify with NumPy
numpy.why_it_matters: NumPy is the foundation of all Python scientific computing, including scikit-learn, pandas, and TensorFlow.

pandas.suggested_project: Perform exploratory data analysis on the Titanic dataset (Kaggle)
pandas.why_it_matters: Pandas is the primary tool for data loading, cleaning, and analysis in Python. Essential for data science.

rest api.suggested_project: Build and test a CRUD API for a bookstore with any backend framework
rest api.why_it_matters: REST APIs are how almost all web services communicate. Understanding them is mandatory for backend and full-stack development.

ci/cd.suggested_project: Set up a GitHub Actions workflow that tests and lints a Python project on every push
ci/cd.why_it_matters: CI/CD automates testing and deployment, enabling fast and reliable software delivery. Expected in all modern engineering teams.

tensorflow.suggested_project: Train a digit classifier on MNIST using TensorFlow/Keras
tensorflow.why_it_matters: TensorFlow (with Keras) is the most widely deployed deep learning framework, used extensively in production ML systems.

pytorch.suggested_project: Implement a simple feedforward network on CIFAR-10 from scratch
pytorch.why_it_matters: PyTorch is the dominant framework for research and increasingly for production. Most new ML papers use PyTorch.

spring.suggested_project: Build a REST API for a student management system with Spring Boot
spring.why_it_matters: Spring Boot is the dominant Java backend framework used in enterprise and fintech applications.

redis.suggested_project: Add Redis caching to an existing Python API to reduce DB queries
redis.why_it_matters: Redis is the most popular in-memory data store, used for caching, sessions, and real-time features.

graphql.suggested_project: Replace a REST endpoint with a GraphQL query in an existing API
graphql.why_it_matters: GraphQL allows clients to request exactly the data they need, reducing over-fetching. Increasingly adopted in modern APIs.

nextjs.suggested_project: Build a blog with Next.js where posts are markdown files rendered at build time
nextjs.why_it_matters: Next.js is the leading React framework for production apps. Commonly required in frontend and full-stack roles.

agile.suggested_project: Run a 1-week sprint on your own side project using a free Trello board
agile.why_it_matters: Almost every software team uses Agile methodologies. Understanding scrum/kanban is expected even for junior roles.
